name: AEC-MEP V1 D: Wrong-Bay One-Axis False Positive Guard
description: Replay a route that matches one axis but lands in the wrong bay and verify that the eval blocks the false positive.
setup_instructions: Use intended route endpoints and landmark relationships that distinguish the correct bay.
Do not count a one-axis-aligned route as correct when the cross-axis bay is wrong.
success_criteria: The eval detects endpoint or landmark mismatch.
No model write is accepted for the wrong-bay route.
The blocked/dry-run status is recorded as evidence.
failure_criteria: The route is accepted because only one axis matches.
Created element ids exist for the wrong-bay route.
grader_notes: This is a negative eval: passing means the wrong-bay candidate was blocked.

landmarkRelationships.relation: route must stay in Unit 405 lower bay
landmarkRelationships.reason: Candidate route matches the x-span but is one bay north of the intended room band.
